names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 28 aprilie, «Sfântul Apostol Sosipatru».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Απριλίου, «Άγιοι Ιάσονας και Σωσίπατρος οι Απόστολοι», whose page heads him «Άγιος Σωσίπατρος ο Απόστολος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 28. април ст. ст., „Св. апостоли Јасон и Сосипатер, и Керкира девица.“ Св. апостоли stands over the first two names and апостол is the `apostle` this folder already carries in `types`; the heading gives him no see and no epithet — Iconium is the body's — so the bare forename is the whole of the Serbian form.
The heading of the calendar's name page 2036, «Апостол от 70-ти Сосипатр», with the apposition left off. The day's line declines it, «Сосипатра».

feast.note: The name page lists «4 января (70 ап.) , 28 апреля , 10 ноября». The 4 января entry is the synaxis of the Seventy Apostles, a synaxis and not a feast; 28 апреля is the day the Romanian calendar keeps him on, and that Russian day page was not read. Both are recorded here as notes, and this row's feast is the 10 ноября day page that listed him.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 ноября ст. ст. — «Апп. от 70-ти Ераста , Олимпа , Родиона , Сосипатра , Куарта (Кварта) и Тертия (I).»

feast.note: doxologia.ro keeps him again on 10 noiembrie, where the day page prints «Sfântul Apostol Sosipatru» (https://doxologia.ro/10-noiembrie, read 25 September 2026) and his page for that day names him «episcop al Iconiei» — the same apostle of the Seventy this row is for. The day's hymn is headed «Troparul Sfinților Apostoli Olimp, Rodion, Sosipatru, Erast, Terțiu, Cvart». The corpus keeps one feast to a church, so he renders on 28 aprilie only.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 28 aprilie — «Sfântul Apostol Sosipatru»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Ιάσονας και Σωσίπατρος οι Απόστολοι»

attestations.note: The life page is one entry for the two and heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους» — **a day later than the 28 April the Romanian row on this folder already carries**, which is the Greek calendar's own day for the same two apostles and not a correction of the Romanian. It is plainly the same pair: apostles of the Seventy, companions and fellow prisoners at Corfu under the ruler Kerkyllinos and the eparch Capreanus, through whom Kerkyra the ruler's daughter, seven imprisoned robbers and the gaoler Antonius came to the faith. **The Greek is much fuller than the Romanian on the questions of origin and of kindred.** It gives Jason as of Tarsus or, by an old manuscript that Nikodemos the Hagiorite notes, of Thessalonica, and Sosipater as of Achaia; rehearses the two New Testament mentions of Jason, in Acts and in the Epistle to the Romans; argues that the «συγγενεῖς» of that epistle most probably means that Paul and Jason were of the same trade rather than kin by blood, citing Chrysostom, Theophylact, Theodoret of Cyrus and Oecumenius for the identity of the Jason of Acts with the Jason of the Epistle; has Jason keep a small weaving workshop in which Paul found work; sets aside Dorotheus of Tyre's report that Jason was one of the Seventy; and reads the phrase of the ninth-century «Πράξεις τῶν Ἁγίων» about Tarsus as meaning that Paul entrusted his own homeland to Jason rather than that Jason came from it. It says that the two were thrown into an iron cauldron of pitch and resin, that Jason came out unharmed and Sosipater died, and that Kerkyllinos repented at it, was catechized, baptized and renamed Sebastianos; and that Jason lived to great old age serving the Church of Corfu and building churches, one of which is reckoned the oldest in the town. **On the relics the page contradicts itself and the contradiction is recorded, not resolved**: its «Ιερά Λείψανα» block puts Jason's skull at the Metropolis of Thebes and Sosipater's at the Metropolis of Thebes and Levadeia, with fragments of both at the Metropolis of Kerkyra and the monastery of Dionysiou on the Holy Mountain, of Jason also at Kykkos in Cyprus and of Sosipater also at the metropolitan church of Veroia; while its closing line says that both honourable heads are kept at the monastery of Hosios Loukas in Boeotia. It gives no year for either man, so this folder's empty `dates` were left empty. It prints an apolytikion and a kontakion that name both apostles and are proper to them, which are stored here; a second apolytikion, «Ἀπόστολοι ἅγιοι, πρεσβεύσατε τῷ ἐλεήμονι Θεῷ», is the common of apostles and was left, as were its megalynarion, oikos and kathisma, which are none of them a kind this corpus holds. saint.gr gives him as «από την Αχαΐα», from Achaia, where this folder's display name has him of Iconium out of doxologia's page for 10 noiembrie; the Greek origin is recorded here and the display name was not changed. The page also links the same calendar's «Άγιοι Ολυμπάς, Ηρωδίων, Έραστος, Σωσίπατρος και Κουάρτος οι Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα», which is the second commemoration the existing Romanian feast note already records.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 11.05.2026 (28. април ст. ст.) — „Св. апостоли Јасон и Сосипатер, и Керкира девица.“

attestations.note: The second name of an enumerated heading of three. The same man: one of the Seventy, Paul's kinsman at Romans 16:21, **of Achaia** by birth where Jason was of Tarsus, made bishop of Iconium, dead on Corfu in deep old age. **It gives no year**, so this folder's empty `dates` stay empty. The Serbian day is Julian 28 April against the Greek 29 April. The entry's whole account of the mission, the seven robbers in boiling pitch, the king's daughter and the king's drowning is set out in this folder's life and in Jason's; the disagreement with saint.gr over whether the persecuting king died in the sea or repented and was renamed Sebastianos is recorded there and resolved nowhere. The Prologue prints no hymn. **A SECOND DAY OF THIS SAME BOOK, added 7 October 2026 by the reader of the Julian 10 November.** That day’s first entry is „Св. апостоли Олимп, Ераст, Кварт, Родион, Сосипатер и Терције.“, an enumerated heading of six in which this man is named «Сосипатер», and its body then prints the cross-reference itself — «Последња тројица спомињу се још и на другом месту, и то: Родион 8. априла, Сосипатер 28. априла, а Терције 30. октобра», the last three are commemorated in another place as well. So the Prologue keeps him on the Julian 10 November too, which it serves at the civil 23.11.2025, read 7 October 2026. One attestation row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and THIS ROW IS OTHERWISE UNCHANGED — same day, same month, same source, same text; he renders on the day above and not on 10 November. What that entry adds to him beyond the day is in the commit message for the Serbian 10 November and not in this folder: it gives each of the six a see or a death in one clause.

hymns.text: Sfinţilor Apostoli rugaţi pe Milostivul Dumnezeu, ca să dea iertare de greşeli sufletelor noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfinților Apostoli Iason și Sosipatru», Glasul 3

english.text: O holy apostles, entreat the merciful God to grant our souls forgiveness of sins.

hymns.text: Δυὰς ἡ ὁμότροπος, τῶν Ἀποστόλων Χριστοῦ, Ἰάσων ὁ ἔνδοξος, Σωσίπατρος ὁ κλεινός, συμφώνως τιμάσθωσαν οὗτοι γὰρ δεδειγμένοι, τὸν τῆς χάριτος λόγον, ηὔγασαν ἐν Κερκύρᾳ, εὐσεβείας τὸ φέγγος, πρεσβεύοντες τῷ Κυρίῳ, ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ἠμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε, on the page of «Άγιοι Ιάσονας και Σωσίπατρος οι Απόστολοι»

english.text: Let the pair of like manners among the apostles of Christ, Jason the glorious and Sosipater the renowned, be honoured with one voice; for these, having been shown forth, made the word of grace and the radiance of piety to shine in Corfu, interceding with the Lord for our souls.

hymns.text: Τοῖς δόγμασι τοῦ Παύλου καταυγασθέντες, γεγόνατε φωστῆρες τῆς οἰκουμένης, τρισμακάριοι· καταυγάζετε γὰρ ἀεί κόσμον θαύμασιν, Ἰάσον, ἡ πηγή τῶν ἱαμάτων, Σωσίπατρε, Χριστοῦ Μαρτύρων κλέος, Ἀπόστολοι θεοφόροι, προστάται τῶν ἐν ἀνάγκαις, καθικετεύσατε Θεῷ, τοῦ σωθῆναι τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Χειρόγραφον εἰκόνα, on the page of «Άγιοι Ιάσονας και Σωσίπατρος οι Απόστολοι»

english.text: Illumined by the teachings of Paul, you became lights of the whole world, O thrice-blessed ones; for you shine upon the world for ever with wonders — Jason, the fount of healings, and Sosipater, the glory of the martyrs of Christ. O God-bearing apostles, protectors of those in straits, entreat God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Апостоли святии,/ молите милостиваго Бога,/ да прегрешений оставление// подаст душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 ноября ст. ст. — «Тропарь апостолов», the common of the apostles, printed under no one name on the day whose apostolic entry is the line of six of the Seventy that names him

english.text: O holy apostles, pray to the merciful God, that He may grant the forgiveness of our offences to our souls.

hymns.text: Божественным светом ум озаривше,/ витийская плетения мудре разористе,/ и языки вся уловивше, апостоли славнии,/ Владыце приведосте,// Троицу Божественную славити научающе.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 ноября ст. ст. — «Кондак апостолов», the common of the apostles, printed under no one name on the day whose apostolic entry is the line of six of the Seventy that names him

english.text: Having lit up your minds with the divine light, you wisely undid the woven arguments of the orators; and having caught all the nations, O glorious apostles, you brought them to the Master, teaching them to glorify the divine Trinity.

hymns.text: Явися днесь/ апостол честное торжество,/ подающее яве всем/ прегрешений оставление,// совершающим их память.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 ноября ст. ст. — «Кондак апостолов», the common of the apostles, printed under no one name on the day whose apostolic entry is the line of six of the Seventy that names him; the page prints two kontakia under that one label, in глас 2 and глас 4, and this is the second

english.text: Today the honoured festival of the apostles has appeared, plainly granting the forgiveness of their offences to all who keep their memory.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 10 ноября ст. ст. closes «(I)», the first century, for all six of the apostles it names, and neither of the two life pages behind his name page gives him a year.
